dependency_edges.handoff: Reconciled reports and population feed external state construction.
State and adjacency feed transition fitting.
Reconciled Census factors feed internal regressions.
External prediction feeds fusion and risk labels.
Internal predictions feed fusion and risk labels.
External interface feeds harder temporal validation and propagation.
Internal interface feeds fit and imbalance diagnostics.
Validated external Q feeds epicenter scoring.
Bounded logistic probabilities feed vulnerability ranking.
Rankings, failures, and boundary findings feed sensitivity and the DEA handoff.
